preprints/Polynomial-PEPS-approximation-.note: Existence of a polynomial-bond PEPS is not an efficient construction or contraction algorithm. Constants depend on fixed local dimension, interaction norm and global spectral gap. Area-law companion is an explicit unreviewed dependency.

preprints/Memory-and-precision-in-noisel.note: The model is one-pass finite-state exact Gaussian regression, with M bits, independent rows, fixed finite horizon and angular error. This is not a theorem for arbitrary neural-network parameter counts or multi-pass training.
